output: The dataset does not provide the necessary information to answer the query about the principal component values of PC1 during the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE), as the relevant columns in the "pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv" dataset are entirely composed of missing (NaN) values.
